messages:
Incident Bot: [ALERT] prod-east preproc service: p99 spike on /v1/generate-stream. detected 2026-03-15T02:14:03Z

Carlos (oncall): seeing it. paging SRE rotation and eng-runtime. tagging @Maya and @Arjun. starting triage.

Maya (SRE): grabbing pager. what are the SLOs hit? need p95/p99 and error-rate.

Incident Bot: metrics snapshot: p95=1.9s -> 3s, p99 jumped to ~8.6s, error rate rose 0.3% -> 2.4%. traces indicate long time in prompt-construction / template-render step. CPU on preproc nodes >= 92%.

Carlos (oncall): short summary: streaming stalls (tail latency), heavy CPU/blocked goroutines in template rendering path; high correlation with requests that enable deep JSON-mode validation.

Arjun (eng-runtime): attaching sample goroutine dump: many goroutines blocked in renderLoop awaiting template mutex. suspecting expensive recursive expansion for tool schemas.

Priya (eng-ml): we flipped json_mode_v2 on some routes yesterday for stricter tool/schema validation. that might be the trigger.

Maya (SRE): if json_mode_v2 expands nested tool schemas eagerly, that explains CPU and queueing. mitigation options: 1) disable json_mode_v2 for affected routes (fast), 2) enable short-circuit streaming path (emit prefix), 3) scale preproc and add payload size limits.

Carlos (oncall): execute mitigation path: toggle json_mode_v2 off for suspect routes and spin up extra preproc replicas. also apply temporary ingress throttle for oversized payloads.

Arjun (eng-runtime): executing commands now:
```
kubectl -n prod-east scale deploy/preproc --replicas=7
curl -X POST https://control-plane.prod/configs/preproc -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"json_mode_v2":false}'
# ingress rule
iptables -A INPUT -m length --length 200000:0 -j DROP
```

DevX: reminder: turning off json_mode_v2 disables some schema checks and deep tool resolution; acceptable short-term but watch for malformed-tool calls.

Maya (SRE): patch applied. deploying a small canary hotfix that makes template expansion non-blocking for initial token emission (emit prefix immediately, continue background resolution). Arjun, Priya, please confirm behavior in canary.

Arjun (eng-runtime): pushed canary to 2 pods. initial telemetry: p95 improved to ~370ms, p99 down to ~1.3s. error rate back near baseline.

Priya (eng-ml): repro in staging: render time for nested tool arrays grows superlinearly. added a minimal repro script and created ticket RWI-9877. also saw increased heap churn when parsing deep schemas.

Lena (product): any customers impacted? need list for CS and comms.

Maya (SRE): CS flagged three high-volume tenants in prod-east sending large JSON-mode payloads; they saw streaming stalls but most calls completed. drafting brief customer note.

Customer Success Bot: sent interim notice to affected customers: "We applied a mitigation to reduce latency on streaming requests in prod-east; engineering is investigating root cause; next update in 45 minutes." Customers acknowledged.

Carlos (oncall): follow-ups:
- keep json_mode_v2 off on affected routes for 2 hours, then evaluate metrics
- maintain canary hotfix and monitor templateRenderDuration histogram
- add temporary ingress rule: payloads > 150KB are rate-limited per caller
- schedule RCA with owners Arjun, Priya, Maya

DevX: raising SDK advisory: client-side warning for payloads > 80KB; recommend splitting tool lists or sending tool handles instead of full schemas.

Arjun (eng-runtime): further notes: reproduced pathological case where nested tool properties trigger repeated traversals; patch plan: memoize schema expansions, avoid full AST rebuild per request. created RWI-9877 with proposed changes.

Maya (SRE): observability action items: tag traces with json_mode flag, emit templateRenderDuration metrics, add alert: templateRenderDuration.p99 > 2s -> page SRE.

Priya (eng-ml): temporary mitigation validated in staging. will collaborate with Arjun on optimizer for template rendering and to reduce allocation churn.

Carlos (oncall): monitoring window. current status: mitigations deployed, p95/p99 trending down, customers notified. I'll stay on until 06:30 UTC then hand off to @Sam.

Sam (oncall-next): acknowledged, will monitor dashboards and alerts. leave logs and notes in the incident doc.

Lena (product): scheduling a post-incident review tomorrow 11:00 PT. deliverables: RCA, customer impact summary, rollout plan for rendering optimizer, SDK advisory.

Carlos (oncall): thanks team, great quick coordination :thumbsup:. closing channel in 30m if stable.

Incident Bot: Incident marked as MITIGATING. Incident ID RWI-INC-20260315-2246
